ConversionResult.title: ConversionResult
ConversionResult.description: One conversion: the output as base64 with its media type and sha256, and the findings about the source (report) and the output (validation). Every surface (HTTP, sidecar, CLI) produces the same result for the same input.

output_name.description: A file name for the output: the input's name, new extension.

complete.description: False when a size or time limit stopped the conversion.

lossless.description: True when no convert finding of severity warning or error.

output_base64.description: The output's bytes, standard base64 (RFC 4648, padded).

DiggsFindingsDocument.title: diggs-findings 1.1
DiggsFindingsDocument.description: Findings about DIGGS instance files and AGS4 files, as written by pydiggs (pydiggs validate --format json). Version 1.1 adds to 1.0 the steps ags4 and convert, the optional location.path and the optional files[].format; every 1.0 document is a valid 1.1 document. A new optional field is a minor version; renaming or removing a field is a 2.0.

$schema.description: The schema the document was written for: this one, or 1.0, whose documents are valid here.

schema_version.description: Major.minor version of this schema the document follows.

reference_data.description: Upstream commit of each vendored DIGGS reference-data source (from PROVENANCE.toml).

path.description: Relative to the working directory when the file is under it, else the bare file name; absolute only when asked for.

format.description: What kind of file this is; diggs when absent. New in 1.1.

diggs_version.description: DIGGS profile the file was checked as (2.5.a, 2.6, 3.0.0), or null when it could not be told or the file is not DIGGS (always null for an AGS4 file).

status.description: not-diggs: the root element is not a DIGGS Diggs element; only the structure step ran.

verdict.description: Derived from status, steps and findings: not-diggs or unreadable from the status; else not-valid if any finding is an error; else partly-checked if a step is partial or incomplete; else valid-with-warnings if any finding is a warning; else valid.

error.description: Why an unreadable file could not be read.

status.description: partial: no error, but part of the step could not be checked offline (dictionary.offline); incomplete: the step could not finish, or lost findings to max_findings (see the structure.findings-truncated finding). A step with an error is failed (or incomplete), never partial.

rule_id.description: Stable id; the part before the first dot equals step.

message.description: Human-readable text. Never compare it; compare rule_id and location.

xpath.description: Element path in the official diggs:get-path form, e.g. /diggs:Diggs[1]/diggs:samplingFeature[2].

gml_id.description: gml:id of the nearest element at or above the problem.

path.description: Place in a source that is not XML. For AGS4: GROUP, GROUP/row or GROUP/row/HEADING (rows are DATA rows, counted from 1), e.g. GEOL/12/GEOL_LEG. New in 1.1; absent for a place in XML.

source_snippet.description: The offending element's XML, at most 1 KiB; present only when snippets were asked for.

DiggsModelComponent.description: A record nested inside another node (a casing, water strike, well opening, SPT drive set, cone, constituent ...), kept as a node of its own.

role.description: The DIGGS property that holds it. Open vocabulary.

unit.description: The axes' unit when they share one.

components.description: EPSG codes of a compound CRS's parts.

DiggsModelCrsComponent.description: One component of a CRS. Facts come from pyDIGGS's EPSG subset (EPSG Dataset, owned by IOGP; see pydiggs.crs.epsg_source()); a code not in it has only epsg.

unit.description: The coordinates' unit when the CRS states one (a projected CRS's, or a linear referencing method's units).

known.description: Whether pyDIGGS found what it names: the EPSG codes in its subset, or the gml:id in the file.

local.description: gml:id of a local or linear referencing system defined in the file.

DiggsModelDocument.title: diggs-model 1.0
DiggsModelDocument.description: The normalised, version-agnostic model of one DIGGS file that pydiggs.read() returns (pyDIGGS 1.7 and later). Open for consumers: objects accept unknown fields and string vocabularies are open, so a 1.0 consumer accepts any 1.x document. A new optional field or vocabulary value is a minor version; anything else is a new major. Coordinates and values are kept as written; nothing is converted or transformed silently.

$schema.description: URL of the schema the document follows.

schema_version.description: Major.minor of diggs-model; pre-releases add -draft or -beta.N.

complete.description: False when a limit stopped reading; members read so far are kept.

limits_hit.description: Which limits stopped reading; empty when complete.

features.description: Sampling features: boreholes, soundings, wells, and every other kind.

measurements.description: Tests, monitors, surveys: every measurement member.

others.description: Top-level members with no typed mapper yet (header, links, extra).

crs.description: Every coordinate reference system used, by key (the srsName as written).

links.description: Every edge in document order; both directions are derivable.

notes.description: What reading had to work around, as diggs-findings findings. Notes are not a validity verdict.

index.description: Columns that place each row: position (position_1 ... for more axes) for a multi-point location, top and base for one interval per row.

crs.description: srsName of the index values; key into the model's crs table.

DiggsModelExtraNode.description: A child element no typed field consumed, kept in document order.

lrs.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

construction.description: How the feature was built: method, casing, backfill, hole diameter, flush, advancement, events; a well's casing, openings and installation events.

parent.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

DiggsModelFieldLocation.description: Where one value of a node was read, relative to the node's xpath.

key.description: gml:id when present and unique, else '@' + xpath. Unique in the model.

element.description: DIGGS element name, after version aliases.

lrs.description: crs key of the linear referencing system.

source.description: Key of another node in this model.

target.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

DiggsModelLithologyLayer.description: One layer of a lithology observation.

classification.description: Shortcut: the primary lithology's classification codes (classificationCode, classificationSymbol, legendCode, lithologyClassification).

colour.description: Shortcut: the primary lithology's colour code.

geologic_unit.description: The unit name the layer gives.

components.description: The layer's lithologies (primaryLithology, componentLithology), each with its constituents and colour nested.

feature.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

items.description: Key of another node in this model.

specimen.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

results.description: Every result set under the measurement (outcome and procedure); columns have no values when read with results=False.

DiggsModelObservation.description: An observation system (lithology typed; others generic).

feature.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

DiggsModelOther.description: A top-level member with no typed mapper yet.

results.description: Every result set under the member.

DiggsModelParam.description: A simple value: a quantity (the element had a uom), a code (a codeSpace) or text.

DiggsModelParams.description: Simple values by DIGGS element name: every child with no child elements that appears once and has no attribute but uom or codeSpace. Everything else stays in extra.

coordinates.description: As written, in the CRS's own axis order.

crs.description: Key into the model's crs table.

geographic.description: Filled in core only for geographic CRSs; datum recorded, never shifted.

transformed_by.description: Set only by pydiggs[gis], e.g. 'pydiggs[gis] pyproj 3.8'.

components.description: Nested records: SPT drive sets, equipment, trials, sieve analyses ...

client.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

DiggsModelProvenance.description: Where the node is, in the same form as a diggs-findings location.

fields.description: Filled only by read(..., provenance="field"): for each child element the node read a value from, keyed by its local name (name[2] for a second one).

si.description: Present only when the unit converts; never silently.

location.description: The single point the whole table was measured at, when the result gives one.

extent.description: The single interval the whole table was measured over, when the result gives one.

DiggsModelSample.description: A Sample. interval, method and recovery are copied from the sampling activity that produced it; type is its classification.

feature.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

sampling_activity.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

feature.description: Key of another node in this model, or null.

sha256.description: Of the bytes as read; scopes every key.

detected.description: False when the caller named the version.

DiggsModelTimeSpan.description: A time instant (start only) or interval, each end exactly as written.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Switch on `code`; every text is fixed.

kind.description: For invalid-document: why the bytes are not a document of the expected format (DIGGS XML, or AGS4 for a conversion).

RuleInfo.title: RuleInfo
RuleInfo.description: One rule id pydiggs can emit (or an open family, as a pattern).

SarifLog.title: SARIF 2.1.0 log
SarifLog.description: A SARIF 2.1.0 log with one run (sent for Accept: application/sarif+json).
